breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained a contradiction: requesting a gamma-centered k-point grid and also a Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift. These two are mutually exclusive. The ground truth resolved this by removing the mention of the half shift. The generated specification failed to resolve the conflict and instead included both contradictory instructions: 'Use a gamma-centered, automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift.'
